input.command:
echo "--- Add second book ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books \
  -d "title=Project Hail Mary&author=Andy Weir&notes=" | grep -E "^HTTP|^location"
echo ""
echo "--- List books (find ids) ---"
IDS=$(node -e "import('./lib/store.js').then(s => s.listBooks()).then(b => { b.forEach(x => console.log(x.id, x.title, x.status)); })")
echo "$IDS"
ID1=$(echo "$IDS" | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
ID2=$(echo "$IDS" | tail -1 | awk '{print $1}')
echo "ID1=$ID1  ID2=$ID2"
echo ""
echo "--- GET /books/<id> ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/detail.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID1
grep -E "The Pragmatic Programmer|Andrew Hunt|reading since|Update notes|Mark as finished" /tmp/detail.html
echo ""
echo "--- POST /books/<id>/finish ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID1/finish | grep -E "^HTTP|^location"
echo ""
echo "--- GET detail page (should now show finished badge) ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID1 | grep -E "finished [0-9]|badge done|Move back"
echo ""
echo "--- POST /books/<id>/notes (update) ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID2/notes \
  -d "notes=Rocky is the best character." | grep -E "^HTTP|^location"
echo ""
echo "--- Verify notes saved ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID2 | grep -E "Rocky"

part.text:
Done. Run it with `npm start` (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3000).

**Files**
- `server.js` — HTTP server with route table
- `lib/store.js` — JSON file storage (`data/books.json`)
- `lib/views.js` — HTML rendering
- `data/books.json` — starts as `[]`
- `package.json` — added `start` and `dev` scripts

**Routes**
- `GET /` — currently reading + finished (counts shown)
- `GET /books/new` + `POST /books` — add form (title required, author + notes optional)
- `GET /books/:id` — detail page with title, author, notes, status, and an inline notes editor
- `POST /books/:id/finish` / `/reopen` — flip status (303 redirect back to the detail page)
- `POST /books/:id/notes` — update notes from the detail page

**Notes**
- Zero dependencies — uses `node:http`, `node:fs/promises`, `node:crypto`.
- Writes are serialized via a promise chain so concurrent POSTs can't clobber the file.
- The detail URL `/books/<uuid>` is the shareable link.
- All HTML is escaped (`lib/views.js:1`).
- Verified end-to-end with curl: create, list, detail, finish, reopen, update notes, 404s, and persistence across a server restart.
